data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 长椅边的一枚秋叶
data.description: 秋日公园里，约尔穿系好腰带的米色风衣与及膝皮靴，侧坐在木长椅上，双膝自然并拢。一只手举着刚拾起的红枫叶，另一只手扶在长椅边，她把叶片转向阳光，红眸专注地看着透亮的叶脉，露出安静的笑。铺满落叶的小路从椅背后延伸。
data.promptProse: Yor sits sideways on a wooden park bench in a belted beige trench coat and knee-high boots, knees naturally together. She turns a red maple leaf toward the sun with one hand while the other braces on the bench. The three-quarter medium view follows a leaf-covered path behind the seat. Soft afternoon sidelight reveals the leaf veins and her attentive red eyes, shading the coat under her wrist.
data.action: 侧坐长椅，一手将红枫叶举向阳光，另一手撑住椅沿。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, seated environmental portrait
